和.o: Phonosemantic compound. 口 represents the meaning and 禾 represents the sound.
w: to settle (a dispute out of court)
x: 和你的车比起来，我的车很小。
Hé nǐ de chē bǐqǐ lái, wǒ de chē hěn xiǎo.
Compared with yours, my car is small.
双方都做了妥协以求和平。
Shuāngfāng dōu zuò le tuǒxié yǐqiú hépíng.
Both sides have made compromises in order to achieve peace.
食品安全，和谐万家。
Shípǐn ānquán, héxié wànjiā.
Safe food, safe community.

而.o: Originally a pictograph of a beard, now written as 耏. The current use as a conjunction is a phonetic loan.
x: 你要去参加，而且你还要敢于发言，敢于辩论。
Nǐ yào qù cānjiā, érqiě nǐ hái yào gǎnyú fāyán, gǎnyú biànlùn.
You are going to participate – and you will dare to speak and debate.
仅此而已。
Jǐn cǐ éryǐ.
That is all.
对于世界经济而言，状况同样如此。
Duìyú shìjiè jīngjì éryán, zhuàngkuàng tóngyàng rúcǐ.
As far as the global economy is concerned, the situation is the same.

里.o: A village (里) is an area of land (土) where people have fields (田). In simplified Chinese 里 is also used to mean "inside", while in traditional Chinese this meaning is written with a separate character 裡.
x: 谁在这房间里？
Shéi zài zhè fángjiān lǐ?
Who is inside this room?
那里有三个人。
Nàlǐ yǒu sān ge rén.
There are three people over there.
哪里都有我的朋友。
Nǎlǐ dōu yǒu wǒ de péngyǒu.
I have friends everywhere.

c.h: 彳 is a component form of 行.
夂 is a component form of 止.

後.o: Depicts someone's foot (夂) being held back by a rope (幺), preventing them from being able to walk (彳) forward.

w: won't do; be out of the question; be no good
x: 我觉得这方法行。
Wǒ juéde zhè fāngfǎ xíng.
I think this will work.
请对本次服务进行评价。
Qǐng duì běn cì fúwù jìnxíng píngjià.
Please rate this service.
拐杖的作用是帮助行动不便的人。
Guǎizhàng de zuòyòng shì bāngzhù xíngdòng bùbiàn de rén.
The purpose of a walking stick is to assist those those with mobility issues.

c.h: Depicts a large object like a shoulder carriage.
Alludes to people speaking together to communicate.

同.o: Depicts a large object (凡) like a shoulder carriage that requires the cooperation of multiple people working together to carry.
w: to agree; to consent; to approve
to study at the same school; fellow student
x: 同一个世界，同一个梦想。
Tóng yīge shìjiè, tóng yīge mèngxiǎng.
One World, One Dream.
不同国家有不同的侧重。
Bùtóng guójiā yǒu bùtóng de cèzhòng.
Different countries have different priorities.
我的态度是同意和支持。
Wǒ de tàidù shì tóngyì hé zhīchí.
I am in agreement and will lend support.

二.o: Two horizontal strokes, representing the number two.
w: the second time; second; number two
x: 你这人怎么这么二！
Nǐ zhè rén zěnme zhème èr!
Why are you so incorrigibly stupid!
买电脑花了一千二。
Mǎi diànnǎo huā le yī qiān èr.
Buying the computer cost me a thousand and two hundred bucks.

題.o: Phonosemantic compound. 頁 represents the meaning and 是 represents the sound. The character is based on the original meaning "forehead". The current meaning is a phonetic loan.

完.o: Phonosemantic compound. 宀 represents the meaning and 元 represents the sound. The 宀 component is used because putting on a roof completes the process of constructing a building.
w: to finish; to end; to complete
to be finished; to be done for; ruined
x: 你的作业做完了没有？
Nǐ de zuòyè zuòwánle méiyǒu?
Have you finished your homework?
我完全清醒。
Wǒ wánquán qīngxǐng.
I'm wide awake.
请按时完成你的论文。
Qǐng ànshí wánchéng nǐ de lùnwén.
Please complete your paper on time.

希.o: Composed of 爻 (cross shape) and 巾 (cloth). 爻 is here used to depict the pattern of the cloth. Originally depicted a type of cloth. The meaning later shifted to "sparse", "rare", and "hope".
w: to wish for; to desire; hope
x: 希望你明天能来。
Xīwàng nǐ míngtiān néng lái.
I hope you can come tomorrow.
希望你一切都好。
Xīwàng nǐ yīqiè dōu hǎo.
Wish you all the best.

界.o: Phonosemantic compound. 田 represents the meaning and 介 represents the sound.
x: 世界之大，无奇不有。
Shìjiè zhī dà, wúqíbùyǒu.
The world is so big that nothing is too bizarre.
这是在全世界都公认的。
Zhè shì zài quánshìjiè dōu gōngrèn de.
This is recognized all over the world.
没想到短短一个月，他的厨艺竟然已进步到这个境界！
Méi xiǎngdào duǎnduǎn yīge yuè, tā de chúyì jìngrán yǐ jìnbù dào zhège jìngjiè!
Who would have thought that in a short little month, his cooking would have improved to this extent!

c.h: 糹 is a component form of 糸.

續.o: Phonosemantic compound. 糹 represents the meaning and 𧸇 represents the sound.

c.h: Originally depicted an axe being carried. Later reanalyzed into phonetic component 哥.
Depicts a person opening their mouth.

歌.o: Originally depicted a person carrying an axe while singing. Now a phonosemantic compound. 欠 (pictograph of a person opening their mouth) represents the meaning and 哥 represents the sound.
w: singing voice; fig. original voice of a poet
x: 这位歌手唱的歌很好听！
Zhè wèi gēshǒu chàng de gē hěn hǎotīng!
The songs this singer sings are fantastic!
他的歌声太好听了，我完全被他征服了。
Tā de gēshēng tài hǎotīng le, wǒ wánquán bèi tā zhēngfú le.
His singing voice captivated me.
他弟弟是位小有名气的青年歌手。
Tā dìdi shì wèi xiǎo yǒu míngqì de qīngnián gēshǒu.
His little brother is a popular young local singer.

c.h: Shorthand for the 啻 component in the traditional character 敵.
攵 is a component form of 攴.

敌.o: Simplified form of 敵. Phonosemantic compound. 攵 represents the meaning and 啻 represents the sound.
x: 两军协力去进攻敌人。
Liǎng jūn xiélì qù jìngōng dírén.
The two armies joined forces to attack the enemy.
法西斯主义是人类的敌人。
Fǎxīsīzhǔyì shì rénlèi de dírén.
Fascism is the enemy of humanity.

验.o: Phonosemantic compound. 马 represents the meaning and 佥 represents the sound. Based on the original meaning "type of horse". The current meaning is a phonetic loan. Simplified form of 驗.
w: to inspect; to examine; to test
to test; to put to the test; trial
x: 实验样品被杂菌污染了。
Shíyàn yàngpǐn bèi zájūn wūrǎn le.
The experimental sample was contaminated by miscellaneous microbes.
这个实验出现了不可解释的超常现象。
Zhè ge shíyàn chūxiàn le bù kě jiěshì de chāocháng xiànxiàng.
The experiment revealed paranormal phenomena that could not be explained.

誌.o: Phonosemantic compound. 言 represents the meaning and 志 represents the sound.

双.o: Simplified form of 雙. Depicts a pair of hands.
w: set of two, pair, couple; both
bilateral; both sides; both parties involved
x: 本协议自双方签署之日起生效。
Běn xiéyì zì shuāngfāng qiānshǔ zhī rì qǐ shēngxiào.
This agreement shall come into effect upon the date of signing of both parties.
双方合作互动，效果良好。
Shuāngfāng hézuò hùdòng, xiàoguǒ liánghǎo.
The two parties worked well together.

囌.o: Phonosemantic compound. 口 represents the meaning and 蘇 represents the sound.

职.o: Phonosemantic compound. 耳 represents the meaning and 只 represents the sound. Simplified form of 職.
x: 这四种职业很危险，胆子小的人，根本干不了。
Zhè sì zhǒng zhíyè hěn wēixiǎn, dǎnzǐ xiǎo de rén, gēnběn gàn bù liǎo.
These four occupations are very dangerous and not for the faint-hearted.
他为了这个职位不惜卖友求荣。
Tā wèile zhège zhíwèi bùxī màiyǒuqiúróng.
He did not hesitate to betray his friend to obtain the position.

富.o: Phonosemantic compound. 宀 represents the meaning and 畐 represents the sound.
x: 知识分子是国家的宝贵财富。
Zhīshifènzǐ shì guójiā de bǎoguì cáifù.
Educated people are valuable assets to the country.
他具有丰富的想像力。
Tā jùyǒu fēngfù de xiǎngxiànglì.
He has a great imagination.

c.h: ⺼ is a component form of 肉.
北 also serves as a meaning component.

背.o: Phonosemantic compound. ⺼ represents the meaning and 北 represents the sound.
w: behind; at the back; in the rear
to go against; to be contrary to; to violate
back (of a human or other vertebrate, or of an object)
x: 你背唐诗背了多少首？
Nǐ bèi Tángshī bèi le duōshǎo shǒu?
How many Tang poems have you memorized?
我跟你讲背后的故事。
Wǒ gēn nǐ jiǎng bèihòu de gùshi.
I'll tell you the story behind it.
男朋友背着我和其他女生聊天。
Nánpéngyǒu bèi zhe wǒ hé qítā nǚshēng liáotiān.
My boyfriend chats with other girls behind my back.

c.h: Shorthand for the sound component 猒 in the traditional character 厭.

厌.o: Simplified form of 厭. Phonosemantic compound. 厂 represents the meaning and 猒 represents the sound.
w: to be weary of; to be fed up with; tedious
to loathe; to hate; disgusted with sth
bored; fed up with sth; sick of sth
not to mind taking all the trouble (idiom)
x: 你真讨厌！
Nǐ zhēn tǎoyàn!
(playful) You are so annoying!
讨厌死了！
Tǎoyàn sǐ le!
(playful) So annoying!

掌.o: Phonosemantic compound. 手 represents the meaning and 尚 represents the sound.
w: palm of hand, sole of foot, paw
palm of the hand; classifier: slap
x: 演得不错，给你鼓鼓掌吧！
Yǎn de bùcuò, gěi nǐ gǔ gǔzhǎng ba!
Bravo! I'll put my hands together for you!
你要变被动为主动，掌握主控权。
Nǐ yào biàn bèidòng wèi zhǔdòng, zhǎngwò zhǔkòngquán.
You must change passive into active, and take the initiative.

牌.o: Phonosemantic compound. 片 represents the meaning and 卑 represents the sound.
x: 我就剩一张牌了！
Wǒ jiù shèng yī zhāng pái le!
I have only one card left!
奥运会的时候，我们关注金牌的运动员。
Àoyùnhuì de shíhou, wǒmen guānzhù jīnpái de yùndòngyuán.
During the Olympics we pay special attention to gold medalists.
中方警告印度不要打「西藏牌」。
Zhōngfāng jǐnggào Yìndù bùyào dǎ “Xīcáng pái”.
China warns India not to play the “Tibet card”.

c.h: In ancient China, shells were used as currency.

赌.o: Phonosemantic compound. 贝 represents the meaning and 者 represents the sound. Simplified form of 賭.
w: to bet; to make a bet; a wager
stake (in a gamble); (what is at) stake
to act in a fit of pique; to get in a huff
x: 我跟你打赌，他明天不会来。
Wǒ gēn nǐ dǎdǔ, tā míngtiān bùhuì lái.
I bet you that he will not come tomorrow.
他在赌场发财了。
Tā zài dǔchǎng fācái le.
He made a pile at the casino.

桌.o: Phonosemantic compound. 木 represents the meaning and 卓 represents the sound.
x: 杯子在桌上。
Bēizǐ zài zhuō shàng.
The cup is on the table.
把桌子挪到那边去。
Bǎ zhuōzi nuó dào nàbiān qù.
Move the table to that side.
把书放在书桌上。
Bǎ shū fàng zài shūzhuō shàng.
Put the book on the desk.

嫌.o: Phonosemantic compound. 女 represents the meaning and 兼 represents the sound.
w: to be a suspect (in a crime)
to regard with disdain; to shun
x: 我女朋友嫌弃我胖。
Wǒ nǚpéngyou xiánqì wǒ pàng.
My girlfriend doesn't like me being overweight.
民警守株待兔将嫌疑人抓获。
Mínjǐng shǒuzhūdàitù jiāng xiányírén zhuāhuò.
The police arrested the suspect after waiting and hiding there.

乌.o: Simplified form of 烏. Pictograph of a crow. Similar to 鳥.
w: black dragon; unexpected mistake or mishap
x: 西谚有云：每朵乌云都镶著一条银边。
Xīyàn yǒu yún: měi duǒ wūyún dōu xiāng zhe yī tiáo yín biān.
As the Western proverb goes, "Every cloud has a silver lining."

貌.o: Phonosemantic compound. 皃 represents the meaning and a remnant of 豹 represents the sound.
w: to appear to be; to seem as if
x: 盯著别人看很不礼貌。
Dīng zhe biérén kàn hěn bù lǐmào.
It's not polite to stare.
你这人有没有礼貌，讲不讲道理啊。
Nǐ zhè rén yǒu méi yǒu lǐmào, jiǎng bù jiǎng dàolǐ a.
Where's your manners? Be reasonable!

册.o: Simplified form of 冊. Pictograph of strips of bamboo strung together. In ancient China writing was done on bamboo strips.
x: 这本书印了五万册。
Zhè běn shū yìn le wǔ wàn cè.
50,000 copies of this book were printed.

跌.o: Phonosemantic compound. 足 represents the meaning and 失 represents the sound.
w: decline (in value); extent of a drop
to fall into; to dip below a certain level
x: 他跌倒了，又爬了起来。
Tā diēdǎo le, yòu pá le qǐlái.
He fell down, but he got back up.
油价昨天跌了。
Yóujià zuótiān diē le.
Oil prices fell yesterday.

c.h: The modern form looks like 曰 (to speak).

昌.o: Originally composed of 口 (mouth) and 日 (sun), representing a call in the morning to wake people up at sunrise to start working. Based on the original meaning "call loudly", now written as 唱. The current meaning is a phonetic loan.
x: 这个国家曾经十分昌盛。
Zhège guójiā céngjīng shífēn chāngshèng.
This country was once very prosperous.

c.h: 氵 is a component form of 水.

涌.o: Phonosemantic compound. 氵 represents the meaning and 甬 represents the sound. Simplified form of 湧.
w: surge up, bubble up, gush forth
to emerge in large numbers; to spring up
to surge up violently (of ocean, river, lake etc)
to well up; to boil out; to bubble forth
to spill; to overflow (of water, crowds)
x: 海面波涛汹涌，近半数旅客晕船。
Hǎimiàn bōtāoxiōngyǒng, jìn bànshù lǚkè yùnchuán.
The sea was rough and nearly half of the passengers were seasick.
地铁站里涌出无数疲惫的面孔。
Dìtiězhàn lǐ yǒngchū wúshù píbèi de miànkǒng.
Countless weary faces poured out of the subway station.

c.h: 忄 is a component form of 心.

慌.o: Phonosemantic compound. 忄 represents the meaning and 荒 represents the sound.
w: to lose one's head out of fear (idiom)
in a great rush; in a flurry
x: 枪炮声使群众惊慌失措。
Qiāngpào shēng shǐ qúnzhòng jīnghuāngshīcuò.
The crowd panicked at the sound of the guns.

癌.o: Phonosemantic compound. 疒 represents the meaning and 嵒 represents the sound.
x: 他得了肺癌，活不了多久。
Tā dé le fèi'ái, huó bù liǎo duōjiǔ.
He got lung cancer and won't live for long.
癌症是人类的头号杀手。
Áizhèng shì rénlèi de tóuhào shāshǒu.
Cancer is the number one killer among humans. (figurative)

c.h: ⺮ is a component form of 竹.

籌.o: Phonosemantic compound. ⺮ represents the meaning and 壽 represents the sound.

穌.o: Phonosemantic compound. 禾 represents the meaning and 魚 represents the sound.

舌.o: Depicts a tongue sticking out of a mouth.
w: tongue; clapper of bell; KangXi radical 135
dispute or misunderstanding caused by gossip
lively discussion with everybody talking at once
x: 我跟他舌吻了。
Wǒ gēn tā shéwěn le.
I French kissed him.

w: very early in the morning; in the wee hours
be high up in the sky
to be above; to place above
x: 任何人都不能凌驾于法律之上。
Rènhé rén dōu bù néng língjià yú fǎlǜ zhī shàng.
No one is above the law.

w: to kill germs; to disinfect; to sterilize
x: 实验样品被杂菌污染了。
Shíyàn yàngpǐn bèi zájūn wūrǎn le.
The experimental sample was contaminated by miscellaneous microbes.

忌.o: Phonosemantic compound. 心 represents the meaning and 己 represents the sound.
w: to be jealous of (sb's achievements etc)
to avoid as taboo; to avoid by all means
taboo; to avoid as taboo; to abstain from
x: 政府挺忌讳这个的。
Zhèngfǔ tǐng jìhuì zhège de.
The government considers this a taboo topic.
孟静娴她太聪明了，她的猜忌迟早会害了王爷的！
Mèng Jìngxián tā tài cōngmíng le, tā de cāijì chízǎo huì hài le wángyé de!
Meng Jingxian is too clever, her jealousy will hurt His Highness sooner or later!

陌.o: Phonosemantic compound. 阝 represents the meaning and 百 represents the sound.
x: 我跟陌生人在一起吃饭，多少有点儿别扭。
Wǒ gēn mòshēngrén zàiyīqǐ chīfàn, duōshao yǒudiǎnr bièniu.
It's a bit awkward for me to eat with strangers.
狗朝著门口的陌生人咬了几声。
Gǒu cháo zhe ménkǒu de mòshēngrén yǎo le jǐ shēng.
The dog barked a few times toward the stranger at the door.

c.h: ⺼ is a component form of 肉.

肌.o: Phonosemantic compound. ⺼ represents the meaning and 几 represents the sound.
w: skin; flesh; fig. close physical relationship
x: 他每天锻炼，肌肉很结实。
Tā měi tiān duànliàn, jīròu hěn jiēshi.
He works out every day, and his muscles are firm.
运动前要先放松肌肉。
Yùndòng qián yào xiān fàngsōng jīròu.
You should loosen up your muscles before exercising.

彌.o: Phonosemantic compound. 弓 represents the meaning and 爾 represents the sound.

軌.o: Phonosemantic compound. 車 represents the meaning and 九 represents the sound.

c.h: 氵 is a component form of 水.

灌.o: Phonosemantic compound. 氵 represents the meaning and 雚 represents the sound.
w: to imbue with; to inculcate; to instill into
to fuddle; to befuddle; to inebriate
x: 诈骗集团用甜言蜜语灌受害人，简直是一碗迷魂汤。
Zhàpiàn jítuán yòng tiányánmìyǔ guàn shòuhàirén, jiǎnzhí shì yī wǎn míhúntāng.
The scam group used sweet talk to deceive the victims — it was practically a bowl of soul-bewildering soup.

w: muddled and completely collapsing (idiom); in an awful condition
to collapse (of building); to topple over
to subside; to sink; to cave in
talus slide; to crumble (of scree slope)
to cave in; to collapse; landslide
to be hell-bent on; dead set on sth
x: 我的财政情况一塌糊涂。
Wǒ de cáizhèng qíngkuàng yītāhútu.
My finances were in a deplorable state.
轰隆一声巨响，房子倒塌下来。
Hōnglōng yī shēng jùxiǎng, fángzi dǎotā xiàlái.
The house collapsed with a thundering sound.
她死心塌地地跟着那个男人。
Tā sǐxīntādì de gēnzhe nàge nánrén.
She devotes herself to that man.

嬌.o: Phonosemantic compound. 女 represents the meaning and 喬 represents the sound.

煌.o: Phonosemantic compound. 火 represents the meaning and 皇 represents the sound.
w: gold and jade in glorious splendor (idiom)
x: 这座城市有辉煌的历史。
Zhè zuò chéngshì yǒu huīhuáng de lìshǐ.
This city has a glorious history.
这座宫殿金碧辉煌。
Zhè zuò gōngdiàn jīnbìhuīhuáng.
This palace is resplendent in gold and green.

雌.o: Phonosemantic compound. 隹 represents the meaning and 此 represents the sound.
w: to speak off the cuff; to casually opine
to have a show-down; to fight for mastery
x: 这只大熊猫是雌性。
Zhè zhī dàxióngmāo shì cíxìng.
This giant panda is female.
雌鸟的羽毛没有雄鸟漂亮。
Cíniǎo de yǔmáo méiyǒu xióngniǎo piàoliang.
The female bird's feathers are not as pretty as the male's.

頌.o: Phonosemantic compound. 頁 represents the meaning and 公 represents the sound.

c.h: Represents words coming out of the mouth.

兌.o: Depicts words (八) coming out of a person's (人) mouth (口).

c.h: 飠 is a component form of 食.

餌.o: Phonosemantic compound. 飠 represents the meaning and 耳 represents the sound.

碌.o: Phonosemantic compound. 石 represents the meaning and 录 represents the sound. Simplified form of 磟.
w: with a rolling or twisting movement
x: 忙碌能使她忘掉一切。
Mánglù néng shǐ tā wàngdiào yīqiè.
Being busy helps her forget everything.

c.h: 氵 is a component form of 水.

泌.o: Phonosemantic compound. 氵 represents the meaning and 必 represents the sound.
x: 这位医师专攻泌尿科。
Zhè wèi yīshī zhuāngōng mìniàokē.
This physician specialises in urology.

c.h: 扌 is a component form of 手.

拌.o: Phonosemantic compound. 扌 represents the meaning and 半 represents the sound.
